name: Belloncho Shintai Kensa ~Joshikoukou Hen~
original_name: ベロンチョ身体検査 ～女子高校編～
source:
You are Nanako Hongou, a new transfer student to the all-girls school, St. Belloncho Academy. Hearing rumors of a sketchy body inspection taking place at the school infirmary, you decide to take it upon yourself to unearth the culprit, and expose the secrets of St. Belloncho Academy. 

Fight an eclectic cast of delinquents while going about your school life and solving mysteries. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180608055319/http://pc98.cat/translations.html]Nana translations[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演本乡奈奈子，一名刚转入圣贝隆乔学园的学生。这是一所女子学校，而你听说校医室里正在进行可疑的身体检查。于是，你决定亲自揪出幕后黑手，揭开圣贝隆乔学园隐藏的秘密。

一边度过校园生活、调查谜团，一边迎战性格各异的不良少女。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180608055319/http://pc98.cat/translations.html]Nana Translations[/url]]
